outcome: Neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) admission rate
finding: Fetuses with growth restriction and abnormal umbilical artery Doppler findings (REDF or AREDF) were at increased risk of a number of adverse perinatal outcomes, including caesarean delivery, low birth weight, low Apgar scores, NICU admission, and perinatal mortality.
mod_finding: Neonates with abnormal umbilical artery Doppler were at increased risk of cesarean delivery.
